commands.command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== GUI APPS ==='; (find /Applications "$HOME/Applications" -maxdepth 2 -name '*.app' -print 2>/dev/null || true) | sed 's#^.*/##' | sort -fu | grep -Ei 'inkscape|cura|orca|prusa|slicer|repetier|pronterface|printrun|octoprint|freecad|fusion|openscad|blender|vscode|visual studio|bambu|idea|arduino|platformio|serial|terminal|gcode|laser|lightburn|kicad' || true; echo '=== BREW CASKS ==='; (brew list --cask 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -Ei 'inkscape|cura|orca|prusa|slicer|repetier|pronterface|printrun|freecad|fusion|openscad|blender|bambu|lightburn|serial' || true; echo '=== BREW FORMULAE ==='; (brew list --formula 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -Ei 'vpype|printrun|octoprint|serial|gcode|openscad' || true; echo '=== COMMANDS ==='; for c in vpype kobra-plot pronterface pronsole printcore cura orca-slicer prusa-slicer slic3r openscad FreeCAD inkscape octoprint hostops uv python3; do p=$(command -v "$c" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$p" ] && echo "$c => $p"; done; echo '=== UV TOOLS ==='; (uv tool list 2>/dev/null || true); echo '=== PYTHON PACKAGES ==='; (python3 -m pip list 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -Ei 'vpype|printrun|octoprint|pyserial' || true; echo '=== SERIAL PORTS ==='; ls /dev/cu.* 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'usb|serial|wch|ch34|modem' || true
